title: MV Advanced javascript question concerning YEP_BattleStatusWindow

posts.author: Fortunastreet
ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Fortunastreet said:
I think I have found the cause of it: in YEP_BattleStatusWindow line 251 there is code added when an action is cleared or its skill/item/itemobject is set.
Click to expand...
I'm confused by you saying the modification solves your problem, because none of that should be happening during what you show in your clip.
The Game_Action is the skill actually resolving during the battler's turn. It doesn't exist yet when you're scrolling through the list - the window you show with the items listed there should have nothing to do with the data type you're looking at.
